priorityList: Maintain Arcane Intellect and use Mirror Image before combat starts.
Activate Combustion at the end of a hard-cast (Flamestrike, Pyroblast, or Fireball) or immediately before a Meteor impacts.
Use offensive Trinkets, Racials, and Potions when Combustion has more than 6 seconds remaining.
Cast Meteor during Combustion as long as the buff has at least 2 seconds remaining.
Spend Hot Streak procs on Flamestrike if 4 or more enemies are present, otherwise spend them on Pyroblast.
Spend Pyroclasm procs on Flamestrike (4+ enemies) or Pyroblast, ensuring the cast finishes while Combustion is still active.
Use Fire Blast off-GCD while casting to convert Heating Up into Hot Streak, but do not use it if you already have a Hot Streak proc.
During filler phases, spend Hot Streak or Hyperthermia procs on Flamestrike (4+ enemies) or Pyroblast.
Outside of Combustion, use Meteor if 4 or more enemies are present and Combustion is nearly ready (within 1-2 GCDs).
Use Meteor outside of Combustion for Blast Zone or Sunfury Execution benefits if Combustion is more than 12 seconds away.
Spend Pyroclasm procs outside of Combustion only if the Combustion cooldown is greater than 12 seconds or you have 2 stacks.
Cast Scorch if the target is below 30% health (with Scald talent) or when Heat Shimmer is active.
Use Fireball as your primary filler to generate Heating Up when no procs are available.
If Bloodlust is active, prioritize using Meteor before activating Combustion to maximize Sunfury benefits.
Prioritize Scorch over Fireball during filler phases if there are 4 or more enemies and the target is below 30% health.
